info.title: absuite
info.description: The ABS command-line client: sign in, read your profile and workspaces, and call the governed ABS API.

commands.name: account
commands.description: Your sign-in and workspace for this profile and server.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --profile
options.description: The settings profile to use (default: the current one).

options.name: --url
options.description: The ABS server address, e.g. https://example.com.

options.name: --tenant
options.description: The workspace (tenant) ID to act in.

options.name: --output
options.description: table (the default; human also works), json, jsonc, tsv, yaml or none.

options.name: --no-input
options.description: Never ask a question: anything that needs input fails with exit 2 and names the flag to pass. Also on when stdin is not a terminal, or CI or ABS_NO_TUI is set.

options.name: --query
options.description: A JMESPath expression applied to the result before it is printed, e.g. --query "[].name".

options.name: --only-show-errors
options.description: Show only errors on standard error: no warnings or notices.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Say on standard error what the command runs with.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Also trace each HTTP call on standard error: method, address without its query, status and time. Never headers, tokens or bodies.

commands.name: count
commands.description: Count the workspace's account-groups. Reads GET /api/v2/AccountingService/AccountGroups/Count.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a record in the workspace's account-groups. Sends POST /api/v2/AccountingService/AccountGroups. Field flags are listed under Options; --json or --file takes the same fields. Never set here: id (set by the server); timestamp (set by the server).

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete one of the workspace's account-groups. Sends DELETE /api/v2/AccountingService/AccountGroups/{accountGroupId}; asks first unless --yes.

commands.name: get
commands.description: Show one of the workspace's account-groups. Reads GET /api/v2/AccountingService/AccountGroups/{accountGroupId}.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the workspace's account-groups. Reads GET /api/v2/AccountingService/AccountGroups.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Change one of the workspace's account-groups: reads it, applies --json/--file and the field flags, then sends PUT /api/v2/AccountingService/AccountGroups/{accountGroupId}. Field flags are listed under Options; --json or --file takes the same fields.
